content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- **§12.3 (p0050)** affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service and to operate in any field or territory, and confirms Customer has made no non-compete commitment — this satisfies the preferred element outright, so no redline is warranted.
- **§2.1 (p0012)** adds that there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment; **§13.1** grants Customer a non-exclusive licence (in our favour); **§13.4 (p0056)** is ordinary acceptable-use language, not a competitive or field-of-use covenant.
- **§2.2** (Vendor as sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services) is a sourcing exclusivity reviewed under the exclusivity rule; it does not restrict Customer's own products, brand or businesses, so it is not double-flagged here.
